units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 665:10">Yalk. Lev. 665</cite> <he>כיון דחסלין מן פְּשִׁיטֵיהוֹן</he> when they had finished their studies; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352">Yalk. Is. 352</cite> <he>מפשוטיהן</he>.

senses.gloss: plain, self-evident truth; is it not a matter of course? Meg. 3ᵇ, a. fr. פ׳ לי I have no doubt.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:5:3">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פ׳ דא מילתא וכ׳</he> this is clear, that &c. Y. Sabb. X, end, 12ᵈ <he>מה דצריכא לר׳ י׳ פ׳ לי׳ וכ׳</he> what to R. Jeremiah is doubtful, is clear to Isaac ben U.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 137a:13">B. Bath. 137ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ מהו דתימא וכ׳</he> is not this a matter of course (what need was there to say it)? (Answ.) I might have thought &c.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 16a:6">B. Mets. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ זבנה וכ׳</he> it is undisputed, if he sold it …, but if he made a present of it (to the robber), there is a difference of opinion &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q02072"><he>פְּשִׁיטָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:3:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מילין … פ׳ לכון פ׳ וכ׳</he> things doubtful to the Rabbis are clear to you; those clear to the Rabbis, are doubtful to you.
<cite ref="Chullin 54b:4">Ḥull. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>כפ׳ זוטרתי</he> like a small P.—Pl. <he>פְּשִׁיטֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 54b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ דפומבדיתא</he> the small coins of Pumb’ditha.
B. Mets. 16ᵇ פ׳ דספרא the writer’s fee, v. זוּר ch.—Trnsf. flat and round blisters.
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:17">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>קאי בישריה פ׳ פ׳</he> his body was full of blisters.
